BrochureContent.Content:
.Dixon Residential Estate Agents are delighted to present 7 Brackenwood Avenue to the Balbriggan property market.

This beautifully presented two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment offers an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers and investors alike.

Upon entering, you are welcomed by a spacious hallway leading to a bright and airy open-plan kitchen and dining area, located at the front of the property. This inviting space is ideal for everyday family living as well as entertaining guests. Further along the hallway is the recently renovated family bathroom, finished to an exceptionally high standard.

The generous master bedroom features a modern en-suite bathroom, walk-in wardrobe, and direct access to a private balcony. A spacious second bedroom and ample storage throughout complete the accommodation.

The property enjoys a highly convenient location just a one-minute walk from the Castlemill Shopping Centre, where a wide range of amenities and services are available, including Dunnes Stores, a medical centre, pharmacy, convenience stores, hair salon, and various cafés and restaurants.

Residents can enjoy the many attractions the area has to offer, including sandy beaches, the harbour, and Ardgillan Castle with its stunning parklands. The locality also benefits from a wide variety of sporting and recreational facilities, including golf, GAA, football, rugby, and cricket clubs.

Balbriggan is home to the renowned Irish Institute of Music and Song and the popular Lark Theatre.

Connectivity is excellent, with the M1 Motorway just a five-minute drive away, providing convenient access to Dublin Airport, the Dublin Port Tunnel, and Dublin City Centre. Balbriggan Railway Station is within walking distance, offering regular commuter services to Dublin city and surrounding areas.
